variant: Export invoice (02) in USD with FOB delivery terms
source_request: Postman apidian-v2.1 / 07 - Otros tipos de Facturas / Factura de exportacion
derived: Fictitious issuer, customer and dates; lines, totals and variant fields as in the Postman request; Incoterm changed to FOB, the USD currency fields of tests/golden/invoice/foreign-currency-usd added and the k_supplement exchange rate set to the same TRM
php_bugs: The first version of this case had no k_supplement. With deliveryterms and no k_supplement, InvoiceExportController::store (lines 55-73) creates a k_supplement that only holds FctConvCop, and fetches that value from the live TRM service when the request omits it. The template _ubl_extensions.blade.php then reads k_supplement.responsible_incharge, so the request fails with HTTP 500 "Undefined array key responsible_incharge". An export invoice with Incoterms needs a complete k_supplement in the PHP.
